description: What happened to a record, newest first, through one of four lenses (`kind`): "fields" (default; per-field changes with before/after, for "who changed the status and when"), "versions" (whole-record snapshots; a version id goes to restore_version), "activity" (the full trail including comments, links and attachments) and "document_versions" (snapshots of the description document; an id goes to restore_document_version). Each lens answers a different question. Every row carries `source` (human/agent/automation/mcp). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES get_history"]
name: get_history
title: Get record history
